comments: Friendly host, can be a loud area but convenient. Overall a good and comfortable stay. Cat is friendly too.
great stay, clean, Anna was attentive and checked in often. Answered all questions. clean small space with a great kitchen area. in a nice neighborhood.

Great location with lots to do nearby. The space is small, but that was clearly shown in the listing. Just a heads up the shower door is transparent, so something to consider if you’re traveling with friends. The host was very friendly and helpful throughout the stay.
When I come back I’d definitely book/stay here again, host is super sweet and gets back to you at a timely manner. I had to leave quickly and just address with the host, very kind and understanding.

The host was very responsive to any questions we had during our stay. The place was spacious enough for our group of 5. It was also very accessible to two train stations with a 10-15min walk in either direction. With a nice and peaceful walk to the SkyTree. Would love to stay here again on my next visit.

Great location for our group who explored Tokyo Bay and DisneySea on the first few days of our trip. The house was easy to find and is conveniently located near shops and restaurants, and Kasai station. Communication was smooth and clear. We enjoyed our stay. Thank you for hosting us!

Wilbert is a super host, and very accommodating even brought our large suitcase and down when we were leaving. How many host do that!
Jonathan

We had a wonderful stay here. The apartment was very nice, clean, and in a great location. It comfortably accommodated four people. Jack was a fantastic host – the information provided was clear and helpful, and whenever we had questions, he responded within ten minutes. Check-in and check-out were very smooth and easy. I would highly recommend this apartment.

Beautiful stay in a great area.
Thank you for having us!

What an amazing stay we had in Amsterdam . Michelle is a wonderful host , extremely thoughtful and knowledgeable. Her place
Is well equipped, everything like on the photos , sparkling clean bathrooms, comfortable bed and sheets. The neighborhood is close to the Center and the Anne Frank House. There’s plenty of stuff to explore , great food and tons of vintage stores .
Thanks for having us. We’ll definitely be back!

Nice and comfortable flat . Perfect for someone who have to work from home , but location and area is bit scruffy I would say . Flat benefit from nice patio/garden area that is nice bonus over a summer, and is fully fitted for both short and longer stay .
Free Off road parking in the area is also a bonus for someone who needs to travel by car.

Excellent base for exploring Tokyo – quiet neighborhood, easy access to Shinjuku & Shibuya
I had a great stay at Itabashi Cask Village Hotel. If you're looking for a place that's well-connected but away from the non-stop chaos of Shinjuku, this is it.
🚆 Station & Access
The hotel is incredibly convenient. It’s just a short walk (about 5 minutes) to JR Itabashi Station (Saikyo Line) . From there, you’re literally 2 stops to Shinjuku and 3 stops to Shibuya without needing to transfer . Getting to Ikebukuro is also just 1 stop away. It made navigating Tokyo super easy.
🍜 Food & Convenience
The neighborhood is quiet but very well-stocked. There are 7-Elevens and FamilyMarts literally around the corner.

My family and I enjoyed our stay.  The place was clean and the neighborhood was quiet, just as advertised.   There are some cool restaurants in walking distance and a neat little coffee shop across the street.  Would definitely stay here again.
Clean and tidy hotel, worth what I paid.
Great location and a lovely stay. Bigger place than it looks in the pictures. Would definitely stay again and would recommend!

We had a great stay here! From reservation to checkout the host was always very responsive and helpful. They were even able to accomodate an early check in when we arrived sooner than planned. The place is right in the middle of all the action so please do expect some noise as it has a great night life. 2 minutes from Nakano broadway and sun mall. Right next to a ton of restaurants and a family mart. If youre looking for a place close to alot to do in the Nakano area, this is it!
Very fun property, in a great location. Would highly recommend and stay in again.
Exceeded expectations. We had a wonderful trip!

This was a lovely little place, the art inside gave a much appreciated homely feel rather than a typical white walled AirBnB.
The garden which we didn’t grasp was accessible from the listing was absolutely lovely! Walked out the kitchen door into a lovely garden that had furniture to sit out in. Made for a nice evening!
Will be back!
We had the best time! The cats are so sweet and made the space so special. Would stay again!

The room was quite spacious and it was easy for me to hop the 1 train down to midtown or the village each day. It turned out many of friends lived close by in that neighborhood. I didn’t meet Sajad but his two roommates were great and we sat up the first night just talking.

We’ve had a great time staying at Rez’s place. Highlights are being so close to the station, shops and restaurants, Walking distance to Prospect Park- loved hanging out there, and space to relax if you’ve been out and about all day enjoying the hustle and bustle/sights of New York.
Rez was great to communicate with, and checkin/out was easy.
Enjoyed staying here! Easy to find, very close to the train station as mentioned. Room and living area was very clean and organized. Had no problem finding the place and getting in, would recommend.
Perfect just what we needed!
This place met our expectations.  It was very clean and Paul was very responsive.  There was plenty of room for my family of 5.  We liked the location.
Easy access to public transportation, clean and spacious room , comfy bed , clean bathroom, overall really great experience!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
An amazing little flat right in the heart of Soho! Perfect location — just steps from all the theatres, shops, and restaurants. The flat was spotless, stylish, and had everything we needed for a brilliant stay. Couldn’t ask for a better spot to explore London. Perfect place — would definitely come back!

The good: clean, quiet, safe, nice rooftop access, enough space for 3 of us, directions for check-in and check-out were easy to follow, easy tram access to city center.
The bad: We didn't have Wifi the whole time. Host claimed it was a provider issue but I don't think she knew her own Wifi password. Climbing 4 flights of stairs was bad enough but the last flight is being used as storage which is very difficult to navigate with luggage. No extra towels, no wash cloths, no hand towels, no paper towels, no door between shower and bedroom, shower head broken, failed to mention that the bed in the small room is a bunk bed and requires a small person to climb into it, toilet wouldn't flush without removing the tank lid, one of us woke up with new insect bites every morning, host claimed we broke a vase when we did no such thing. Wish we hadn't paid so much to stay here.

Jennifer’s home is such a cute and cozy place! The subway is very close and it’s close to restaurants, shops, and so much more. The location is Perfect! After a busy day running around beautiful New York, it was nice to come home to a quiet and peaceful space! I would definitely book this home again! Thank You Jennifer!
Rosalind and India 🥰
Really enjoyed our stay here. Quiet and comfortable beds! Thank you for everything! We look forward to staying again in the future.
Spacious and centric, and Alicia is a pleasure to deal with.
This place is for those who choose character & authenticity over Ikea cleanliness. Lovely old building. Very friendly & fast communication.

Loved staying at this garden flat in London with my family of 6! The place was beautiful, really well-designed, and full of character. Super comfy and felt like home right away. The location was amazing too, with tons of great shops, restaurants, and cafes just around the corner. The outside garden with a swing was such a nice bonus. Would definitely stay here again!
David’s place is great! Quiet and friendly neighborhood! Spacious and clean.
Everything was fine.

The apartment matched perfectly to our expectations, was clean, had enough space and was comfortable, had everything we needed.
The nearest metro station was 5 minutes away, which is totally fine, took about 20 minutes total to get to Time Square.
Silvia was extremely kind and helpful. Staying there was the best decision, we would do the same way if we would visit NYC again.
Very comfy and easy to check in

The location is perfectly situated between so many walkable neighborhoods, parks, cafes, restaurants, and public transportation. A great place if you don't want to be in central amsterdam.
The hosts were very helpful and the house was lovely.
The steps from the ground floor to where all bedrooms are located are challenging. The top two stairs are especially tricky if you have large luggage or any mobility issues.
A family lives on the second level above the bedrooms, but it wasn't a problem at all.

This is my new favourite Airbnb! 5 star hotel standards in a great location. Beautiful flat, bnb room is in newly refurbished basement floor and is absolutely flawless. Beautifully furnished to a very high standard, great bed, super bathroom, quiet and peaceful street. Already rebooked. Jackie is a really lovely lady too!

It was a really nice place, I had everything I needed very easily, they even left an umbrella in the closet, there’s a small washer machine that is so helpful specially because Tokyo summer is so hot you’ll feel the need to be washing your clothes more often and they also offer the detergent, and then you can just hang them on the balcony, the Airbnb was pretty clean and I would say a corner from shibuya big center, the kitchen is very nice and well equipped and there’s even a studying table.
very enjoyable stay. clean place. extremely central location.

we where going to the O2 for a concert.
normally hotels in the area are £200+
Normans BnB was excellent location, great value and had super fantastic facility's.
Norman is a friendly host , giving excellent directions to the flat.
met us on arrival and showed us all the facilities and explained how to get where.
during our stay both he and his wife where super friendly and we could not want for v anything else.
Nice and warm and good bedroom
Bathroom and shower excellent with towels supplied
Could not want or criticize anything
we will definitely be using this again

Fantastic stay in Tokyo! Host was both responsive and helpful throughout our time at the Airbnb. The unit was sparkling clean. It had everything we needed to make your stay pleasant and enjoyable. Glad to make this our home base in Tokyo during our recent visit ♥️

The place looks exactly like the photos. It’s AMAZING! Incredibly stylish and spotless. The bedroom has the comfiest beds we’ve ever slept in, and the garden room is so cozy and stylish—perfect for relaxing. Arjan truly knows all the coolest spots in Amsterdam and beyond, whether it’s restaurants, shops, or clubs. Truly a Superhost in every way. Thank you, Arjan, for the delicious food and your incredible hospitality. We’ll definitely be back again!
The place is really nice and tidy! Compared to other listings on Airbnb it’s really good for what you pay.

It’s a cool place. the entire hotel feels like a modern museum with vibrant, youthful energy. The only downside was that what appeared to be a window in the photos wasn’t actually openable, which made the room feel less breathable :)
The place is small but very nice! Absolutely lovely neighbourhood with so many parks near by and increasingly close to the train station

I had a fantastic stay at Fabiana’s place. This was actually my second time staying in one of her properties and once again the experience was excellent.
The flat was exceptionally clean, the room was comfortable and the whole place was quiet and well maintained. The location is fantastic, very close to King’s Cross with excellent transport links, making it easy to get anywhere in London. There are also plenty of shops, cafés and amenities nearby.
Fabiana was friendly, helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout my stay. Everything was well organised.
I would highly recommend staying at one of Fabiana’s properties and would definitely stay again on my next visit to London :)
That was a really nice place to live, center fastly accessible by bike and ferry

This apartment is just a quick walk to the L train which will take you right into Manhattan or south into Brooklyn. My friends and I had all that we needed. We were able to cook up a light breakfast one morning, had a couple evening get togethers and enjoyed our time lounging in the common area. You can separate your recycling and compost items from the trash. We played a couple games and put one of the puzzles together. It was mid December when we stayed and was colder weather. There are extra blankets in the drawers under the bed in the room next to the kitchen. The steam heat did a great job of keeping the rooms warm. Excellent water pressure and good hot water temperature with ample towels. The space us up a flight of stairs above the host family who are quick with any needs....oh..and there is a good pizza place just a block or two away. We recommend this place and look forward to our next trip back.
Nice and quiet loft near to métro and to to little shops .we loved it very much.
Great location, super nice hosts, clean place, easy check in/out, and great communication.
Incredible place at an absolutely fair price. Great hosts
Nice boat in a  beautiful location place just far enough out the city to properly relax
Enjoyed my stay very much, place was just as described and very clean. Kitchen is well equipped, bed is comfortable and you feel right at home.

most beautiful space I ever stayed in. super good energy. kinda felt like staying at a friends place. the area is a bit more quiet but there’s still lots of nice cafes and restaurants. also very cute recommendations were provided by the hosts. still walking distance to the more busy areas. 12 out of 10

This is a great flat! Great location, has everything you would need to be comfortable, and more. Barry was super welcoming and let us drop luggage and gave us recommendations in the area! We would recommend and stay again!

Had a great stay at the Holiday Inn Express! My friends and I came from Indiana for 5 nights. Check in was seamless, room was clean, and overall staff was very friendly and responsive. Free breakfast, free wifi, it’s everything you’d expect a hotel to be at a very affordable rate.
My only gripe is that I had to pay $200 in additional hotel fees (not including the $75 damage deposit). Because my group split the cost it is whatever, but I would’ve appreciated knowing before hand.

Tomoko was an amazing host, very attentive, helpful and friendly - she even let me borrow her personal bike for a day which was perfect for exploring the local area! Nakano-fujimicho is a residential and quiet neighbourhood and the station is very nearby. The flat is walking distance to various shops, and also to the lively parts of Nakano and Koenji, and a quick metro ride to Shinjuku etc. I explored many areas across Tokyo in the 5 days I stayed and it was the perfect base - comfortable, spacious and very cosy!
For anyone looking for a place to stay with character, this is perfect. The building has a vintage feel and the flat is homely and simple with all the basics and enough space to make it feel your own.
I hope to return and stay again!
Anna was a great host who was very accommodating and was very responsive. The space is cozy and very convenient for public transportation.

We have a very nice stay at Zaito's place. Very nice area, quiet in the evenings with nice places to eat and have a coffee that felt more local and very well connected with metro. Apartment was very clean and the host very responsive. Overall a good choice to stay.

Note there is only ONE shower compartment on the ground floor which is not the most conducive for families. We travelled as a family of 6 with four kids.
Be careful of steep stairs, it’s split across three levels and dangerous for small children (we had a toddler and baby).
The kitchen is workable but the dining area is a little cramped due to the piano (which you can’t actually use, and they say a fee will be imposed if you use it and spoil it, so why is it there?).
There is a very good udon place 6-7mins walk away, but nearest train station is 10mins walk away and not super near.
We do not recommend for families with children, perhaps a group of adults might be ok. Neighbourhood was so-so because there was nothing immediately surrounding.
Also, we were promised to have a cot and high chair setup for us but this was not done. Instead they sent a package and expected us to set it up ourselves. Rooms did not have much space to fit an additional cot anyway, big luggage was tight.

Chasse Residency Hotel was just right for our stay close to Amstelstation and easy to get into city centre and to Johan Cruyff arena for Harry Styles. lovely friendly staff, super comfy room. Lovely walk down the canal to cool bars and restaurants, gorgeous community gardens/park over the road. Only downside was that for someone who hasn't travelled in Europe for a while it would have been helpful to be warned about tourist tax at point of booking. But do understand it had to be paid. Overall we had a great stay, and would stay again!
Good value and comfortable. Everything you need available.
Wonderful quiet place. Close to bus stops and tube stations. Rita is very hospitable and welcoming. Room is spacious and very comfy with a beautiful view as well.

Beautiful apartment, very comfortable and well equipped. Several good transport options to central London, but we also enjoyed Hackney's local life and Victoria Park. Thanks to Charlotte for her tips and for helping to make our stay a great one.

Inside the apartment nice and as described with good crockery all as shown on picture. Very central location but area surrounding property didn’t feel very safe (particularly for single female). Enrico provided great communication prior and during stay.

Angela is a lovely woman and has a stunning home! She was an excellent hosetss from start to finish and made us feel comfortable. She provided us with a lovely breakfast every morning and provided us with space in her kitchen for our own groceries, which helped alleviate  some of the cost of dining out. We have stayed at other AirBnB accomadations, and Angela's was by far the most enjoyable!

We were so impressed with the neighbourhood.  There is street parking with minor restrictions.  The apartment is perfect.  People in the neighbourhood are very friendly and a very safe place to stay.  Close to great food, shopping and attractions.

It's a great apartment located close to the center. Easy to find and go by walk or public transportation.
Take into consideration the long stairs to reach it.
Robert was great and helped a lot with tips....
Tal

It was my first time traveling outside of the US and I was doing it alone; Merle's place was perfect for exactly that. It was cozy and had everything I needed for my 4 days I was there. I felt very secure and safe being there alone. It was across from a lively bar, but something about it felt very home-y. Totally worth every penny as well and near so many great spots & train/many buses if you're trying to venture to somewhere else! Thank you again :)

I’d like to thank you for everything!
I got a really nice apartment at a great price.
It’s perfect for one person and excellent for two!
I recommend it to everyone!
The accommodation is about a 10–15 minute walk from Shibuya.
But the walk itself takes you through a bustling, lively area full of restaurants and shopping options.
Lawson and 7/11 (open 24/24) are about 2 minutes away.
We plan to come back with friends next year, and we’ll definitely stay here again :).
Thanks for everything,
János Csapó from Hungary

Our stay at Ryo's apartment was great! It's a lovely apartment which has everything you need. We felt welcome and the location was the perfect stay to explore Shimokitazawa. Ryo itself was a great host and really made an effort to meet our needs, which we truly appreciate (especially when traveling with a toddler..). Thanks for a wonderful experience and hope to visit again!

We enjoyed our stay, perfect size for our group of 5. We appreciated the pictures and descriptions on how to arrive because it wasn’t clear on Google Maps. Loved the 7-11, 2 minute walk! Host were responsive and polite, would definitely recommend!
A super amazing place to stay with a wonderful host. The place had great access points to the underground and buses. The host is a great communicator and provides clear instructions.
Excellent! Agree with previous reviews

I had a very pleasant stay at B’s. She was very welcoming and accommodating host. Her place is conveniently located near the tube and the house itself was very quiet for a good night sleep. Separate bathroom is a huge bonus. I’d thoroughly recommend B’s Airbnb to anyone visiting London and I’d stay there again anytime.
Nice location with a very friendly host.
Nice host, easy communication, amazing view. :-)

The apartment was big and clean for the two of us. Walking distance to the Skytree and easy access to subways. The host was super helpful and friendly. I had a great experience here and will recommend to friends and family. Thank you!!!

This lovely little apartment is a true gem. It will be your safe quiet haven in busy and buzzing London City Centre.
The apartment is beautifully built and Annes hospitality is great, everything is taken care of. Fresh flowers, coffee and tea await you. Books and travel guides for trips off the beaten path will entertain you and a wonderful cozy bed will heal your aching tourists body after you came home.
I enjoyed my stay very much - I would live there!
Thank you so much, dear Anne!

We had a great stay here, that we ended up extending our stay twice!
Room was spacious and exactly like photos.
Well equipped kitchen with utensils and good electric cooker.
12 minute walk from the station. Detailed welcome guide which shows you the quickest route to the property.
Owner was responsive and friendly. Thank you for your hospitality!

The place was just perfect, clean and tidy with everything you might need, in and out. Very central location, just a couple of minutes walk to the tube and very close to shops and restaurants. Simon was very helpful showing me around during my check in, and was flexible when I wanted to check out a couple of hours late. Definitely recommended.

I had a great stay here when visiting Amsterdam. I loved how easy it was to access many different spots around the city by foot. I also loved having a garden connected to my room, and the peaceful surrounding area. Gina and her husband were amazing, it was lovely to talk to them both and meet their adorable cat. I highly recommend!

thank you to Mitchell for a really helpful stay for getting back up north obscenely early in the morning, the location was perfect post wedding. the room and environment was clean and comfortable. great communication and was flexible/accomodating with check in. highly recommended.
Great Airbnb. We loved the location and the apartment!

It was just a great experience. Ann and Allen really made us feel at home away from home. They are wonderful people. And the beds! The mattress honestly was the best mattress I have ever slept on!
The shared bathroom did limit our flexibility a little as the other party often used it when we wanted to too. But it was helped by an extra bathroom upstairs by the kitchen which we were allowed to use too.
We would love to come back here and would absolutely recommend it!
Great stay! Perfect for the two day trip! Thank you!

The flat was exactly how it was described. Great location in Soho! Being tucked in the alley was perfect for reducing the sounds from the street, we even slept with the window open and it wasn't a bother. I recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice spot next to a little bit of everything! Our only issue was navigating the stairs with our larger pieces of luggage, but we made due. Also, the communication with Flavio was amazing!

a wonderful, clean and quiet place to stay, super close to metro station and easy to reach Shinjuku and Shibuya for food and shopping. The host Milo is super helpful and responsive. Hope to come back again!

The room was a great place to stay for a couple of nights. It was very clean and quiet. I thought the shared bathroom might be a problem, but it was clean and there weren't that many guests using it so it worked out just fine.  I had no internet connection or cell service in my room, but I was there to sleep so that wasn't really a problem.
Reasonably good place comparatively, but may be a bit expensive likely because of inflation, not necessarily because of the owner.
Great place to stay.

Ryoko's place is absolutely delightful. It's clean, cozy, and very quiet, a great place to wind down after exploring Tokyo. Only minutes from Yoyogi station. There is also a lot to visit in the neighborhood with all the amenities you might need. Would highly recommend!

The flat is great, the only thing to consider is that it is 4 floors up a relatively narrow staircase. If you have large bags this may be a concern. If the stairs aren't a problem, this place is a gem.

We stayed here from May 16 to May 22. We've used Airbnb for 6 years, and this was our worst experience — especially disappointing in our beloved Japan.
The host declined early check-in, explaining the apartment needed proper preparation. Yet at 4 PM it was not clean: dirty floors, a greasy stove with burnt residue, a bathroom with accumulated grime, food crumbs in cabinets and the fridge, dirty windows.
We sent the host photos and videos, and cleaning was repeatedly promised. However, over 6 days no one came — we were only asked to send more photos. A request for an iron was also refused.
Other downsides: a steep staircase (unsuitable for children or elderly guests), an unpleasant sewage smell, a 15-minute walk to the metro, a nearby hospital with ambulance sirens disturbing sleep at night, and no cafés in the area.
The apartment is spacious and the host was polite, but the place was not prepared for our arrival, and the issues were never resolved.

Newly refurbished apartment in a very safe area. A few minutes walk from buses and trains. Warm and homely feeling with the latest high-spec appliances. Property manager was always  immediately available, professional, friendly, even after hours on the weekend. I would definitely return if I get the chance.

Place is amazing just as described cozy London feel
Don’t know why people were saying it’s to hot or to cold place is just fine host is very responsive very easy to check in will definitely book again if need stay I London worth every penny

This was such a comfortable stay. The room is very cozy and private, and really does feel like home for as long as you need it to. There is plenty of space to spread out your stuff and store as needed, and it's very easy to settle down and get work done or even just get some much needed rest because it's so quiet.
The owners are so nice and helpful, but also 100% respect your privacy. Being greeted every morning and every evening by the dogs was an added treat!

We spent 3 nights here. As others mentioned, location was great and very close to the Tube station. The unit served its purpose . The unit and amenities lacked a bit of comfort.
Pros: location, clean, able to drop off luggage as we arrived a couple hours early. Roomy kitchen even though we did not use it much.
Cons: small bathroom w/ almost no counter space, uneven floors which made several doors hard to close & open. Ikea-like furniture which wasn't the most comfortable. Hard pillows. Towels were very rough and dried on the rack. Can smell cooking from the establishment below in the morning.
Thank you so much Yuki and everyone involved. We had a fantastic stay at your property and can’t wait to come back!

Lauren was nice she meet me at the apartment. The neighbourhood was good i would consider it safe. There is a supermarket a couple minutes walk down the road and a bus stop right outside the building.  The apartment was great, cosy and had all the things we needed, very clean.
Great location, nice apartment.

few things were missing from stay, that can be included if feasible.
1.) No iron and iron board.
2.) No dishwasher soap in kitchen
3.)01 additional cooking utensils ( pan can be added).
Above things I felt can be included.
for short stay everything is provided in stay.
since I had long stay for approx 9 days, that's why i needed above items.
dishwasher soap can be purchased from near shop, that should not be an issue.
Positive points are below.
1) walking distance from metro station and skytree.
2.) stay was well cleaned.
3.) Quick response from host.
4.) Every equipment working fine.
Note:: There is only one room in which kitchen is included.
Room size is small. ( I am not sure all Air BNB have small room size or it is Japan culture since hotel room size are also reported small by others)
Host is supportive and caring.
Thank you

I was visiting NYC to see my father and sister and this place was very close to their homes.
Fairly basic accommodations, as advertised, but you really can't beat the price. short walk to subway and all the great food options in Jackson Heights.
the unit is a two bedroom one bath on the third floor of the house. one of the bedrooms was marked personal but I don't think anyone was in it, so I essentially had the whole unit to myself. Large living room and full eat in kitchen. Internet worked well.

Ellen was very friendly and helpful, with good tips&tricks for Amsterdam overall.
good public transport connection to reach Amsterdam central and other areas.

We had a wonderful stay! The location was excellent, making it easy to get around, and the interior design was beautiful, modern, and very inviting. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed.
I had a great stay at Gerry’s. The room was very private and the kitchenette was a massive plus. The location is close to central London. I would definitely recommend.

Great place to stay when visiting Amsterdam, located close to a metro station and lots of cafes and bars locally.
The place is spacious and has a well equipped kitchen space to make your own food.
Mike the host was lovely and really helpful.
Would recommend staying here.

Niko was super accommodating and even took our reservation at the last minute and waited for us to arrive even though we arrived at least 2 hours after said time. The room is super cute. It has the dopest rooftop area and the views are amazingggg. The roommates were welcoming and friendly and were happy to offer up suggestions of things to do. Definitely would stay here again.
Very friendly host, the place is clean and convenient
My stay was great, this space was cozy & very convenient, losts of restaurants, & transportation available. The host had amazing hospitality, i give it 5 stars ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

A great location, easy to go around the city.
The accommodation is great and comfortable .
Thanks a lot for the host for his quick response

Highlights: Beds and blankets are very sufficient. The towels were plentiful and of good quality. Bathroom toiletries had great scents. Water pressure were good.
Lowlights: I recommend having a different way to check-in. For clients who travel from different places and often have limited data communication will be missed. When we checked it took a very long time. Unlike the two other Airbnb, check-ins were both quick and simple. Also, for 3 days and 2 nights, we only have one toilet paper and no dish soap to wash the mugs supplied. The futon mattress was very thin.
But overall we gave this place a five because the highlights I referred to surpassed the AirBnb from Kyoto and is comparable to the one in Osaka.
very nice place and neighborhood, would stay here again
Lovely little move, with everything you need :)
Everything was great!

The apartment is lovely.  Modernized where it is helpful (kitchen all new, brand new laundry machines...), but retains the classic Brooklyn brownstone charm.  Friendly host lives below with their family -- refreshing after many corporate-owned AirBnBs in other cities.
good location for airport
A couple issues with building maintenance but overall a great stay.

Vincent’s place is the perfect LOCATION. With covid going on, and not knowing if things were going to be open, we decided to stay near Central Park and the Met because we know those are open. The location is just a train ride away from everything. We walked to Central Park, The Met, several cute cafes.. we went to Le Pain Quotidien in the mornings because it was one of the ones that still had indoor seating. There is a long waterfront walk that is absolutely GORGEOUS at night just a couple blocks down. All of the train rides were easy to and from. So 5 stars for location. Also it’s only a couple flights up with an elevator and with laundry for purchase at the basement which we were happy about. The bed is memory foam/tempurpedic type which I love. The comforter is so soft I messaged him for the brand lol.  The apartment is SILENT at night. I have to wear ear plugs every night back home, and I didn’t have to use them ONCE here. Shower is hot water which is great and it stays hot for two showers (for me and my sister) back to back. A few things people should know if it means anything to them ... the kitchen is small so I don’t think it would be convenient for anyone trying to cook in for the night ... BUT he does have a stove, microwave, and some pots and pans under the sink. There are no empty drawers for clothing so we just left our stuff in our suitcase or left it on the couch ... if you are an extra large person, the toilet may be uncomfortable for you as it’s in between the wall and sink. Overall, it was a great stay here and we would definitely stay here again!! Thank you, Vincent!!

Very new accommodation, with great location by the market. Easy to get around to the other parts of London.
Many stairs which might not be great for those with heavy luggage.

Reisha is nice and was very helpful and welcoming ; we checked in very late and she was there, waiting for us; we spent a long week at her place -1st floor- which is   very clean  and well situated ,convenient to go sight seing in Manhattan. While there is not a washer/dryer in the unit, there is in the building and once again our hosts were very easy and accommodating in making sure that we had access and did not need to pay extra fees for that. There's also a nice gym set up in the lower part of the building. It has some cardio machines, as well as free weights and machines, bench, and mats. The area was clean and open to use. The apartment was a gem, we'd be happy to return!

The place was spotless and comfortable. The kitchen is fairly well stocked with what you need for cooking. There is oil and salt and pepper. Thanks for the coffee😊 The area is very quiet and we did walk a lot. It’s a bit of a hike to grocery market and to restaurants, But we did it. We enjoyed the backstreets, it was very clean and walkable. You can roll her backyard luggage from the train stations, as all the walkways are so nice. It’s a bit of a hike, so on the way out we took an Uber.

Had a fantastic stay here with my mum and dad. The apartment was pristine and had everything we needed for our 4-night stay. We initially had trouble turning on the hot water and heating, but Eliza was extremely helpful and walked us through the process. Once we were settled in, the rest of the stay was extremely comfortable and peaceful. It was very quiet at night despite being so close to Portobello road. Highly recommend, a perfect base to relax, work or explore the city.
Definitely would come back. Very clean, super convenient, and such a quirky, pretty hotel. Really enjoyed my stay! :)
Lovely and cozy place ! Will recommend.
Lovely room, lovely house, lovely host.

The place was very nice!  Clean, spacious, the furnitures and the unit itself seems new. It is located in a quiet neighborhood. You can walk from the airbnb to the nearest station for around 10mins. There are also convenience stores like 7/11 and Lawson along the way so you can grab snacks or meals for breakfast or before going home. Near the station, there are also groceries, restaurants, bakery, drugstore, and etc. so the place is really convenient for us.

We had an amazing stay for our first time in Tokyo. This airbnb is right by a 7/11 which we loved, several convincing stores, lots of food and the Hatagaya station, which was convenient as we used the subway often. Great for a group that is okay this an open sleeping area like us & plenty of room for showering & toilets. Moeka was a great communicator and even gave us quick response when we asked for instructions on how to get to the airbnb from the airport. Would totally stay here again for a future trip to a tokyo!! 🤍🇯🇵

"We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Vinnie and Wallace's Airbnb! The house was spotless, cozy, and had all the amenities we could possibly need. The couple's warmth and attentiveness made our experience even better—they communicated promptly and were so thoughtful throughout our stay. Highly recommend this gem
Anne-Marie's flat was great and well located for us (close to the Olympic Stadium for the marathon).
Nice accommodation in Nth Amsterdam, within 8-10 walk distance to bus station then catch the metro to CBD. Host Willem is very friendly and easy to communicate.

We were a little disappointed by the building itself and the cluttered entrance full of cleaning supplies. Bedroom window can't be left open because of safety concerns which would have been a dealbreaker for us in warmer weather. There is direct access to an unprotected rooftop. There were some other issues and lack of basic amenities like nightstands which could be easily corrected. After being informed of these, I was told they would be addressed, so hopefully they will. On the plus side, there is plenty of closet space to put your things away but only cheap wire hangers. A few upgrades would go a long way. Host was very responsive and friendly.
Great hospitality ! A Home away from home😍
Great location, host is very helpful and replies quickly

Muhammad is a great host and very responsive. He has provided the necessary assistance. If the cleanser can do their job better that will be great. The location of the apartment is good and close to shops and stations.
Had a wonderful time, excellent location...
Location of this Airbnb is exactly what we wanted! Beautiful surroundings, easy access to the city and countryside. The town of Broek in Waterland had such beautiful nature and local charm.

My friend and I stayed at Luis for 8 days and we were happy with our choice. This was our first airbnb experience and the first trip in New York and all I can say is that it was worth it. The location is more than we dreamed of, near the subway, cool restaurants and shopping streets. Luis appartment is clean and he is a good host. We saw him twice, when he gave us the keys and explained the rules and when we returned him the keys. Thanks Luis for being supernice!

This place was perfect for our 3 night stay in London. The three beds made it perfect for each of us having our own bed and space, though it was tight quarters it was not to tight to warrant us completely getting out of each others way. Write next to Paddington Station and blocks away from Hyde park.  The staff check in/breakfast/maid service were all excellent. Breakfast was perfect with lots of options. But most of all my criteria is always based on cleanliness and this place room/breakfast/halls everywhere was beautifully kept up.  I will definitely stay here again. Thanks Mario for having a great, clean place to lay our heads while seeing your beautiful country.
We enjoyed our short stay while visiting Amsterdam. Didn't spend much time indoors because we were too busy exploring the area. Great location.
Excellent location, quaint, charming, unique space. Easy walking to subway, food, and shopping.

This place was conveniently located within a short tube ride to any London attractions, but away from the bustle. It was a short walk from the tube station.
A couple of grocery stores, a drug store, and some bakeries, coffee shops, and restaurants within walking distance.
The air conditioner was just in the bedroom, but there was a fan in the living room that kept it comfortable when it was 70’s F outside.

Love my stay here! Would definitely recommend! Exactly as pictured! Very clean,
Cozy and comfortable! Thank you Kim for being a great hostess
I am really grateful that the owner has explained everything very well and location also good. Both room and facility is very good.

Really good location, can park for free on the street Saturday night and Sunday if needed. Great nearby cafes and pubs.
Flat was spacious and had all the core essentials you need.

I was absolutely delighted with my stay. I felt like a truly welcomed guest — the hospitality and kindness were exceptional. The apartment is very clean, quiet, and cozy, and I especially want to highlight the bed: it was incredibly comfortable, and I slept wonderfully.
What I found especially sweet — and honestly, it was the first time I experienced this — is that the host shared a list of their favorite places in Amsterdam and personal recommendations on what to visit. It made my stay feel even warmer and more special.
I truly enjoyed my time here and I would love to come back again.
Highly recommended!

the place was lovely and cosy. the location was great, connect by both Jr, subway and bus. Host was very friendly and responsive. Overall a great place to stay and I would highly recommend to those traveling to Tokyo
Great place to stay!
Clean and as advertised. The shared bathrooms were clean and had extra sanitizing wipes for additional comfort. Wifi was great.

Luxury bath towels! Best I’ve ever had at any Airbnb!! Worth it❤️ Comfortable firm bed. Nice shower, next time I hope to experience the rain shower which was temporarily out of commission. Lovely neighborhood, so wonderful to live, breathe, see the canal from your window! Though we didn’t meet them in person, both Tanya and Nicolaas were responsive hosts, allowed us to store our backpacks after checkout so we didn’t have to carry them around in glorious 30c weather. Efficient space, recommend.

A very spacious place in a great location. It takes 8–10 minutes to walk to the nearest subway station. Almost everything was great—we can’t complain. The only things were that the towels were too small, and the pillows took some getting used to.
Place was nice and private. Stefano was very friendly and responsive.

This is what AirBnB is supposed to be like. Charming hosts, clean rooms, beautiful gardens both fore and aft, friendly dog and roly-poly cat.  And a truly perfect street and wonderful house in a great neighborhood. It's just about perfect ...
Nice stay. Just beware of no elevators if you have luggage. Everything else was great.

This is a beautiful apartment in Mayfair with a great location.   I would have rated it 5 stars but it feels very much like an investment property and not a home. There are limited supplies in the kitchen, no table coverings, place mats, paper products, etc. Thomas was very responsive and did us bring us things like a wine opener when we asked.

This place exceeded my expectations as it is  whole apartment, not just a bedroom/bathroom suite  as I initially understood. It was very clean, well stocked and with the right amount of quality very comfortable decor.  The block was quiet and tidy.  It was also near a lovely park and in a very walkable neighborhood.  Shane was very responsive to my questions.  I definitely would book again!
Great place, amazing location. Highly recommend and will stay here again.

My only real "issue" was some confusion about the combo lock* for the main entry into the bldg., and even in that regard, someone was there to let us in 30 seconds after I messaged the host.
While the host was very transparent about the lack of nighttime parking, we actually found very reasonable (almost free) parking only about 2 full blocks towards the water under the BQE.
This place is not fancy, but it's clean, the climate system is powerful and quiet, the mattress firm and comfortable and the internet fast and free.
Really no complaint and perfect if you are basically looking for a 'bed to sleep in' and incredibly close to all 3 NY area airports (EWR was only 25 min, LGA about 35-40 min and JFK probably about the same.
*It's really as simple as ignoring the step of hitting the 'fingerprint' button before entering in the combo. You just enter the 6 digit combo, hit the fingerprint button, and open the door when you see the edge lit green.

This room and owner Annmarie's family is very nice. Location is convenient in 5 minutes on foot from the subway station. We can do a little shopping between the station and the room. The room is very beautiful and relaxing. And the best thing is that the owners live on the upper floors and they were very kind to me. I was able to travel with great confidence. Also when I come back to New York, I will always use this room.

We had a great stay at this hotel. There was a railway strike in Amsterdam that day and was stuck in Amsterdam for another night. We booked this hotel but only had the twin bed available but when we checked in and asked the receptionist if there’s any other room available, she was able to help us! My husband and I were happy!

Overall a great place—expensive, but for our family is was with the extra money. Check in was easy, with our names on the blackboard as you walk in. Very beautiful, well built, and great amenities. We cooked most of our meals while here and the kitchen was amazingly well stocked. The lighting was bright and opened. This was a great place to come home to and relax. Very close to a grocery store. Location is fairly central 10 minute walk to a station either way, the neighborhood was quiet and the Skytree was just one station over. We slept comfortable with our family of 4 if you have littles you will have to watch them closely, lots of steps and the stairs themselves just need extra time for the kids to go up and down safely.
Was great for an overnight stay and is close to the Shepherd's Bush Empire.

We absolutely loved staying here! I thoroughly enjoyed the peaceful location, outside the “bustle” of the city. It really allowed us to truly experience the culture and nature of North Amsterdam. However, it was also a QUICK bike ride to the free ferry across to Amsterdam City, so we could also have the best of both worlds at our fingertips.
Fred was an incredible host. Super friendly and welcoming, and he had a wealth of information of points of interest to experience. We most enjoyed the locations that were in the north, such as the nature sanctuaries and windmills. The location has a number of bike paths available and Fred’s bikes were an indispensable perk!! They really allowed us to explore so much more than we thought we could possibly enjoy.
The room is exactly as he described and was very enjoyable. I loved the balcony for tea and bird watching.
If ever in his area in the future, I will definitely be staying with Fred!
* to add: Fred’s communication was top notch!

HONEST FEEDBACK
This serves to the benefit of future travellers - especially if you travelling from out of town or out of country
My 1 out of 5 rating is for the following reasons:
1. Collecting the keys is such a hassle - especially if you traveling with luggage (travel bags) and you have to do it all over again on check out.
2. The apartment is situated in a residential block and you have no control over the noise or disturbance caused by others. On night two we were woken by a child crying and parents screaming. It was either the case of the parents fighting and it resulted in the child crying or the child crying and the parents shouting at the child. I did flag this with the host the very first night but only got real action once I escalated to Airbnb. Lesson for me is that it’s always best to escalate early.
3. The apartment is located on a busy road so cars passing through the night should be expected.
4. We could not find dish clothes.
More to say. Tan out of characters

The space has a very special character, and is in a cool neighborhood in Bushwick. Rooftop is also a great add to the space!
Teddy was great in communicating with me throughout the whole process of our stay.

We stayed 2 nights in Emmorys adorable 2nd story walk up.  Myself and a coworker had enough space to do our work and keep a few items in the fridge. This great spot was more affordable than a hotel room and   served us well

We greatly enjoyed our stay at YAYS. Whenever I had a question, i got a very quick and helpful response. Check in is easy, it is great that they have so many storage for storage. Also umbrellas to rent for when it is raining. Overall a tidy apartment with comfortable beds. Good location, allows you to walk along the water past the science museum to walk into the man part of the city!
Great place and around 5-10 minute walk from Shin Nakano Station. Only downside is the lack of elevator which might be a struggle for those with big luggages.
Great stay! Location is on point and if I had any questions, they were always fast at responding. Highly recommend staying at this place.
Everything about our stay was smooth and comfortable. The host was responsive from the moment we booked and check out was effortless. Five stars all the way.
This was an awesome place! The location was amazing and there was lots nearby. The apartment was clean and spacious. Highly recommend!
Such a beautiful house in a beautiful neighborhood. Host was really nice and room was very clean. Quiet warm house. I really appreciate.
This was an amazing rental in a great location. We would stay here again.

Beds were very comfortable. It was a good stay.
We stayed here for 4 nights. We were not given any towels. When I asked for towels we were given 1 towel for each person. When we we asked for more towels we were declined! Make sure you pack few towels when you book this Airbnb.
Place is small, but very accessible.   Would consider staying short term again.

LOVED this airbnb. Thomas was very understanding under our scheduling circumstances. The apartment was clean, home-y, and well stocked with essentials. He also has a great book collection! We felt very comfortable and highly recommend booking this airbnb!

My family of 7 love this place. The house was cozy. Plenty of bedroom and restroom for my family. The kitchen was useful and have all we need for easy cooking and dining. The neighborhood was quiet and has a lot of places you can find things to eat. We love the tomato soup ramen across the street. Close to subway and the Skytree. The host was great. The communication was great. Thank you.
Amazing location with various trains close by.  Easy to get to other places in Tokyo. Very crowded streets and a lot of noise level. Be aware if you are sensitive to noise.
The apt was amazing! Location great! John and Maria were very helpful. This place was great would definitely recommend 🤩

My husband and I loved our stay here! We knew Tokyo would be a busy place so we wanted our stay to be away from crowd but still accessible. We were able to walk to Asakusa and lots of bus stops nearby! This is a quiet neighbourhood so if you prefer your stay to be peaceful, highly recommended! The unit itself is cozy, we were able to do our laundry, and as we work remotely, the work desk and chair were a plus! Thank you,  Dash Living Japan! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had a great experience with Joo-Yon! Her house is very nice and she was kind enough to give us a bottle of wine and accommodated our very late check in and late check out.

My recent five-week stay in Chip and Cathy's Airbnb was absolutely fantastic. Their apartment was not only spotless and stylish but also provided a warm and inviting atmosphere. The central location made exploring NYC a breeze, and their thoughtful recommendations enhanced my experience.
What stood out most was Chip and Cathy's genuine hospitality. They went above and beyond, making me feel like a welcomed friend. I highly recommend their Airbnb for anyone looking for a top-notch stay in the heart of New York City. Thank you, Chip and Cathy, for making my time in NYC unforgettable!
Starlee´s place is really nice and perfectly located in Brooklyn. She was easy to reach and communicate. I totally recommend her place!

Everything was as described and pictured! We were gone from the flat most of the time, but it was centrally located and easy to get to and from places. There were also a lot of restaurants within walking area that we could stop at on the way home. Hosts were helpful with recommendations and quick to respond! The electronic key was also super easy!!
The best time…beautiful room equally beautiful views

Bas’s place was wonderful! 😍 Such a good location, you can get to Amsterdam central in under 10 mins and the ferry was so frequent and free, so it was very convenient! 👍🏻 The studio was so nice and felt very cosy too! They even left a vase of fresh flowers! 🌸 Even though it was connected to Bas’s house, it still felt very separate and private too which we appreciated!

Tamara’s place was a beautiful place to stay, spacious and homey in a lovely quiet part of Amsterdam. The boat had everything we needed and was perfect for a long weekend getaway, and she was very flexible and responsive to any messages. We’d definitely come and stay again!

Excellent airbnb for sure. Excellent location and facilities. All needed utilities and equipment. Hot water,comfortable bed, perfect sleep, very clean and warm. It is easy to check in and check out. Good internet, everything we need in the kitchen we did find. A lot of shampoo and conditioner and toilet papers. Clean spotless towels and bed linen. We had the use for free of washing machine and tumble dryer, and hairdryer and fridge and kettle and toaster and cutlery. The place was warm, and hot water was available all the time immediately. For sure, the best stay. I will be back every time I need a place for me with the family or if I need to stay in central London for work. Strongly recommend. Thank you again :)

Place was amazing with an amazing view and great location to access everything we personally needed. Check in was easy, room was stylish and up to date with fridge, blow dryer, safe for valuables and a desk to work at! I would love to stay here again!
Decent value for money. Simple room close to Heathrow airport and good for staying close by for an early next day flight. Host left clear instructions on how to find the property and check in.
This is really a central apartment. 10 min away by tran to van Gogh and Rijk museums.

Very nice dialogues about important topics of life and was a very cosy and nice house. A bit noisy due to Airline traffic but this was already mentioned. Thank you Sarah for being such a nice and uncomplicated host. Bests, Reinold
Very nice appartment. Good location and puböic transport. clean. Loved it

The apartment itself was cute and safe, but my overall experience wasn’t great. Cristine and I agreed on a check-in time, but when I got there she was unresponsive for over 10 minutes and made us wait in the cold. I also did not feel like there was very much respect coming from Cristine. I did not feel welcomed. We had to carry 4 suitcases up 3 flights of stairs which was not easy in the slightest so if you have a lot of luggage, I wouldn’t suggest this home.
we really enjoyed the place. it does meet our American Standard. highly recommended
Everything was perfect as described. Spacious rooms and comfortable beds. The host was very supportive in all queries and prompt responses.
Perfect location. The apartment was nice and cozy. Really enjoyed the stay.

There was only a very limited space to hang things, which wasn’t really sufficient. Also, there was no proper shower curtain, so the water was getting the toilet and the whole bathroom floor wet.
Other than that, everything was great 😊 Muchas gracias por el hospedaje.
Great place to stay at if you’re looking to stay in Amsterdam super friendly and great host, while also a great apartment with lots of space near the city centre, overall a great experience :)
Amazing stay, very quiet location

The apartment was perfect for our stay, had everything we could have wanted in a safe & secure building. In exactly the area we wanted to be, easy walking distance from Victoria Station. Great communication and very responsive - we asked if we could store our baggage pre check in time & instead we could check in nice and early. Gave us the opportunity to add a walk to and around Battersea Power Station to our itinery, really helpful. Just perfect for our visit of a couple onf nights.

Had a wonderful stay. Alberto and little dog Hamish were a pleasure to stay with. it is a lovely apartment to work from. Great balcony with lots of sunlight. It's a great location. You can walk to Spitalfields market in 25 minutes. Great transport links. Bus to London Bridge is very frequent and runs 24 hours. You also have Haggerston overground station very close by. I would definitely stay here again. Being by the canals is really lovely.
We had a great time, this location was great and easy to reach the trains and Tower of London!

We had an amazing experience staying at this house in Sumida City. Every single detail of the home was thoughtfully designed, and you can really feel the care and effort put into the space. The aesthetics were stunning—clean, modern, cozy, and very Japanese-inspired. It honestly felt like staying in a beautifully curated home rather than just an accommodation.
The house was spotless, well-organized, and extremely comfortable. Everything we needed was provided, and the layout made the stay feel relaxing and effortless. I especially loved how each corner of the house looked so intentional and aesthetically pleasing—perfect even just to sit and enjoy the atmosphere.
Overall, this was one of the best Airbnb experiences we’ve ever had. Highly recommended to anyone who appreciates beautiful design, comfort, and attention to detail. We would 100% stay here again! ✨
Toby was a very responsive and friendly host however his space was not as prepared as it should have been for our arrival. The airbnb was in a great location!

We really enjoyed our stay. The place matched the description perfectly, communication with the host was excellent, and the location was very convenient and well connected. We would happily stay here again!

We only had a one night stay here for a concert so for one night wasn’t too bad however, the sofa bed was rock solid and there were stains all over the couch and on sofa bed mattresses.
The kitchen was not very modern at all, the bathroom door would not open all the way and in the bedroom and living room were 2 walls of brown mirrors that I found very weird.
If you’re looking for something for the night then this would be okay but wouldn’t recommend for anything longer.
Very quiet fr loved it
We really enjoyed our stay, the place was bright, charming and quiet. We would absolutely come back next time in London.
Her place was cozy and really nice. Thank you

The apartment is very much as described. It’s a very nice place we were very comfortable in. The neighborhood was great and very convenient with lots of restaurants nearby and quick access to the tube. My family and I loved it!

The whole Airbnb smelled like smoke and there was a large spot of dirt and very noticeable fluid stain on the bed. Cleaning seems untrustworthy. If the place was actually clean, the Airbnb was rather nice and roomy. Also they could give more towels and better quality towels that don’t feel like rags.
Great apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. Walking distance to lots of main attractions. Clean and accurately described.

Had a great two-night stay at Ryoko’s place! He had a very clear check-in manual that had all the info we needed for a comfortable stay. The shower was the smallest I’ve ever been in, but not a dealbreaker.
Would definitely recommend for a couple or small family as there are two beds :)

The staff is so unhelpful. I found dried blood (not mine!) on my bed under the sheets and asked for it to be changed at the front desk before leaving for the day and she said they would change it. No problem. We were out for most of the day exploring and when I got back to my room they had given me a fan (my first request) and left the sheets. They left a card saying to call room service when I was back but only within certain hours and by the time we go back they wouldn’t do it. It was absolutely ridiculous. They left the BLOODY sheets. Definitely won’t be back.
The place is great, beautifully decorated, very quiet at night, secure and close to the tube. Perfect for a few days in the city.

Great place and nice area for family.We had 12 people and fit perfectly fine. Has everything you need in a home. One thing though you would need to carry your luggage to the 2nd or 4th floor as there isn’t a space to leave luggage in the lower level.
Great stay in quiet and central location for all fun and transport links. Perfect for a large family group.
A really tranquil, comfortable place to stay and a very responsive and welcoming host!
We had an amazing time!

I really enjoyed staying here. Jonathan’s place is around 10mins walk from two subway stations, great for some neighbourhood sightseeing. Room is clean with lots of spaces to put your belongings and some thoughtful touches too. The apartment is small but is very cosy with high ceilings. Check in was smooth, and he has the two most lovely cats! It rained when we were there so we didn’t get to enjoy the patio. But I would definitely do so when I stay here again if they’ll have me ;)

I can only recommend to stay at Eduardo's place. The flat looked exactly like the pictures and as both rooms were free at the time, I could pick the one I preferred. It's very convenient to go anywhere with anything you may need around the place. Getting in the flat was easy, and Eduardo was very reactive via texts in case anything had happened.

The apartment was spacious, clean, in a great location and good value for money. It was quirky, definitely attractive to music lovers. Great location in respect of public transport, restaurants, supermarket, bars, street markets. City centre easy to get to as was other areas of interest. We would love to return with friends and stay again, definitely recommend.

This was our second stay at Aamer’s. We had such a wonderful stay when we arrived in New York City that we booked another stay on the tail end of our trip. We were so grateful for the early check-in and for the flexibility to keep our bags secure after check out. Once again our stay was flawless. Cleanliness and ease of check-in was superb. Highly recommend to other travelers as well. We walked all over the city and loved how central our accommodations were. We will be back!

There was confusion of the location but it wasn’t hard to find after. Building has maybe 8 steep steps up before you get to the elevator. Photos appear the space to be larger, but it was still enough space for 4 people. A little tight if you have a lot of luggage. We had luggage delivery, Mayumi allowed us to use her Japan phone number and helped communicate with the company. It arrived damaged, no longer useable, for a small fee she assisted with disposal of the suitcase which helped a lot. The apartment was clean and comfortable. The first night, men yelling late at night, probably intoxicated, but she provides earplugs. Others were asleep exhausted, thankful they did not hear them. Convenient location, There are a couple restaurants next door and McDonald’s, Lawson, Family Mart, 7-11 nearby. Across the street is the train station. 1 stop away from Shibuya. If driving, there is paid parking lot, a 2 min walk. Due to her  help, cleanliness, location, Would stay again. Thank you Mayumi
Was in a great accessible location! Loved every minute of our stay and was a perfect space for 3!

This place is awesome. Nearby of everything. It’s great place to stay in Amsterdam. The apartment is very clean, cozy and perfect. The visit was perfect mainly due to Miro’s reception and attitude. The bestest host I have seen. Friendly and very happy person, always answering so quickly and helping with all information and support during the stay. Very cool guy. Thanks for everything. I will come back for sure.

We stayed their for 3 nights and it was a perfect location in Tokyo. Sumyca was super proactive, gave us lot of advices and kept checking on us. Apartment was very functional, super safe and very close to many convenience stores which can be practical if needs something last minute. Finally I love running and this is a perfect spot too because you are just a mile from the palace. So you just follow straight the avenue and end at the palace where you can make as many loops as you want. So we definitely recommend the place!
Beautiful house. Great location!!! My family and I had really great time.
Great stay. Convenient and cost effective

Harm was a lovely and responsive host. He kindly allowed us to check in early, which we really appreciated after our luggage was delayed and we needed to shop for clothes. The room was cozy with two beautiful windows overlooking a classic Amsterdam street with restaurants below. The bed was very comfortable, and the fan kept us cool during mild summer weather (around 20°C). As noted in the listing, the home has three steep and narrow staircases, typical of Amsterdam. We had a 23kg suitcase and managed fine, but it’s worth noting. Harm kindly offered to help with the luggage. The bathroom is quite small, with little space for toiletries or doing hair, but there are two mirrors in the room that help. It would be great to add a small surface near the mirror by the books for convenience. Overall, a lovely and comfortable stay in a beautiful neighborhood. Would  recommend!

The good: This airbnb was well-located in Notting Hill, near an easily accessible Tube station and a bus line, as well as close to nice restaurants and shops. The space was comfortable for two people. We also appreciated the washing machine and dishwasher.
The could-have-been-better: There were several small annoyances including no hand soap upon arrival which we had to purchase, the toilet seat lid would not stay up, and there were some large holes in the floor. The place could have been better maintained but was fine for a week long stay.
The not-so-great: Our main challenge was the lack of comm from the host. The reservation stated check in details would be available 48 hours in advance, but we had to follow up with the host who only messaged us 20 hours before the reservation. Moreover, we had an issue with the hot water in the shower. Ultimately this was an easy fix, but since the host took 12+ hours to respond, we went 48 hours without hot water.

Our host Joo-Yon made us feel all right at home, leaving us plenty of informative information about Amsterdam including things to do, see and places to eat. The house was beautifully presented and was situated  in a fantastic location in Amsterdam with plenty of shops, cafes and bars all within walking distance. There was also a tram and pass stop right at the entrance of the building.

Great location close to two train stations. Walking distance to Shinjuku and its attractions. A little noisy at night, but very sporadic. Good value and good location, would definitely stay there again.

We have not quit talking about the houseboat we stayed on! The boat was clean, the people around us were nice and we would do it again and again if we could. Also having the bathrooms and showers at the marina office was a huge plus. Thanks for the lovely stay!

Fabulous stay in Amsterdam in a warm, clean apartment in a perfect location

Catharine goes out of her way to greet and make guests feel welcome.
Thank you.

It was a wonderful space but I wouldn’t recommend for people with young toddlers. There is a noise alarm and it was very easy for our toddler to trigger it. If it’s just adults or a family with older children (maybe 10 and older) then this would be a perfect place to stay

Thank you for having us!
We really enjoyed our stay. The place was basic with a rustic feel but had everything that we needed. The location is great and in a wonderful neighbourhood, off a beautiful leafy street.
What a wonderful apartment! Our family of 7 stayed here for (3) nights to enjoy all of NYC's attractions. The location was central to all of he trains and walkable to major attractions in FiDi.

We cannot fault the place. Our host was always responsive at varying times of the day and little was needed anyway, the flat was in good repair and is a great location for just staying local if on some days you don’t fancy travelling out. We would absolutely stay in Otsuka again and would absolutely stay at this flat again. Thanks so much!

A very large, modern, and stylish space! The apartment is close to public transportation and comfortably sleeps four adults. Communication was quick and easy, and the host met us at check-in. Would absolutely recommend!

Every day I stayed in this beautiful house, I realized that I am glad I chose this place, the location is great, every problem i had there was always quick solutions. You can choose this place with peace of mind.

A great stay in a beautiful place. The garden is just as amazing as in the pictures (and even more enchanting). Sinead was helpful, friendly, welcoming and responsive, providing great local recommendations, and proactively helping us navigate ongoing circumstances (Arsenal parade and tube strikes). The rooms are warm, unique and homely. The garden is a piece of art, something you won't find anywhere else (you might even forget you're in London). Fox, squirrel and bird sightings added to the atmosphere. The area is very well-connected, multiple tube and rail lines will take you anywhere around London. There's a great supermarket near the tube station (M&S Food) and many restaurants of all kinds.
This was a perfect base for our 11-day family adventure around London. Would recommend in a heartbeat and we'll be happy to return anytime.

Nice to stay in somewhat a residential area. Nakano station is a short walk in which you pass dozens of restaurants and convenience stores. Comfy beds & having a clothes washer is great. Good place to stay

A very cute house in a quiet neighborhood, with a 10 minutes walk from a busy shopping street with lots of stores and restaurants and 15 minutes walk to the shinkoiwa train station giving quick access to central Tokyo or Disneyland.
Our kids loved the themed rooms.
Stacey was friendly and the place matched the description perfectly. Great if you want to stay near Wimbledon. Thank you!!

It was the best experience ever
That 100 years old boat is so elegant and so covinnient
I absolutely recommend it for everyone especially for couples

the room was just as it looked and just what I needed. nice little garden to sit in. not too far from the main train station about 35 mins and 5 mins walk to a lovely park. Joe the handsome cat was the highlight of my mornings. I will be back again next year 😊

Amazing stay! 🏠 The flat was clean, cozy, and perfectly located. Communication with the host was super smooth - and extra kudos for posting my forgotten shoes to me, much appreciated! Would definitely recommend 😊"

As a great host, they provide helpful info before and during the trip. The location is excellent, right near restaurants and the train station. However, the place was quite dusty and cleanliness could be improved. Then, it was quite inconvenient that no clothes hangers were provided.
Nice flat in a Great location, good communication.

Loved staying here! The place was super accommodating. It was in a great location and walking distance from a lot of restaurants/bars. The washer and dryer were a great plus and something not a lot of places have included when staying in NY. The size of the place was pretty good, we had three of us staying and it worked out just fine! Overall great experience, highly recommend!

Amazing location! Maria is extremely responsive & the apt is cute, clean and as described.
Only watch-out to families with children is the elevator and door to apt is not standard door width so a side by side double stroller is too wide!

Joukje was extremely friendly and the best host ever! She gave us early check in and late check out free of charge and was always available to answer any questions that we had. The room was clean and couldn’t be in any more of a perfect location. I’d give more than 5 stars if I could. Thank you for providing great accommodations!

We really enjoyed our month at Jenni’s place in Clapton. The interior is stunning — full of character, style, and thoughtful touches like scented candles, palo santo, essential oils, and coffee table books.
The flat is tucked away from the main road, peaceful and quiet (there was a low vibration sound but it quickly became like white noise). The bed is smaller than it looks in photos (around 130 cm wide) but a very comfortable mattress and bedding in general.
Communication with Jenni was excellent — she's warm, responsive, and made everything easy. This is her main home so her belongings are around, but it kind of felt like staying at an older sister’s place, with the bonus of her amazing candles, hair tools, and Aesop soaps.
There's no cell reception, but WiFi is super fast (work calls approved).
The area is great — and there are great parks, cafés, pubs, yoga studios, and restaurants nearby. Overall, a beautiful, welcoming stay we highly recommend!

The host that we met was wonderful and responsive however the furniture has been changed drastically. We questioned if we were in the correct apartment or not at first glance. The location is fantastic but it was not as clean as we had expected and the trash was half full and stinky. I would be willing to stay here again but for a lower price maybe? Stairs leading up to the apartment are very small and steep just a heads up to the next renter!

Harry and Bahar are lovely people. They opened their home to us, and we got a unique opportunity to chat with them about anything and everything over tea… a memorable experience from our visit to London. Their home is clean, comfortable, and close to public transit. Would recommend!
Anna and her family were lovely hosts and I wouldn’t doubt for a second staying with them again on my next visit to London.
